result(status, ref, queued, error) has no correlation field and normalization discards all transport extensions

reason_not_patched: The connected GitHub contents action requires whole-file replacement for both live browser owners. This worker can read exact current source but has no repository checkout/patch runtime; reconstructing large live owners from truncated connector transport would create avoidable corruption risk. A source diagnosis is persisted rather than claiming a partial live fix.
truth_boundary: This evidence proves the current source-level loss point only. It is not a completion claim and does not authorize storing private content.
